symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: A vector space over the field $F$ that contains the line.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ be a vector space over $F$.

symbols.name: scalar multiple
symbols.meaning: A scalar in $F$ that multiplies the nonzero vector $x$ to give a point of the line.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be a scalar, that is, an element of $F$.

symbols.name: second scalar
symbols.meaning: A second scalar, used to check that the line is closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
symbols.quote: if $d$ is also a scalar, $cx+dx=(c+d)x$ and $c(dx)=(cd)x$ lie on it.

symbols.name: triple choice
symbols.meaning: A choice of three triples of the ground set, whose three entries index one triple label.
symbols.quote: For a choice $\varsigma=(\varsigma_1,\varsigma_2,\varsigma_3)$ of three triples, put $u_\varsigma = t_{\varsigma_1}\otimes t_{\varsigma_2}\otimes t_{\varsigma_3}$ and $U_\varsigma = \operatorname{span}\{u_\varsigma\}$.

symbols.name: triple vector
symbols.meaning: The tensor product of the three indicator vectors chosen by $\varsigma$, which spans the triple label.
symbols.quote: For a choice $\varsigma=(\varsigma_1,\varsigma_2,\varsigma_3)$ of three triples, put $u_\varsigma = t_{\varsigma_1}\otimes t_{\varsigma_2}\otimes t_{\varsigma_3}$ and $U_\varsigma = \operatorname{span}\{u_\varsigma\}$.

symbols.name: triple label
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $u_\varsigma$, the label attached to the choice $\varsigma$.
symbols.quote: For a choice $\varsigma=(\varsigma_1,\varsigma_2,\varsigma_3)$ of three triples, put $u_\varsigma = t_{\varsigma_1}\otimes t_{\varsigma_2}\otimes t_{\varsigma_3}$ and $U_\varsigma = \operatorname{span}\{u_\varsigma\}$.

relations.quote: The definition rests on the vector spaces and scalar multiples of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
For a line, nondegeneracy is decided by the [Bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) on the single vector $x$.
Each label $U_\varsigma$ is spanned by $u_\varsigma$, which is built from the [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) of three indicator vectors.
A nondegenerate line $U$ shares only zero with its [Orthogonal complement](orthogonal-complement.md) $U^\perp$
A line of this kind labels the edges of the network that the construction builds from [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md).
